categories.summary: The discussion centered on ElizaOS's organizational structure and SOC 2 compliance. A key technical clarification was provided regarding ElizaOS's security certification status: elizacloud uses SOC 2 Type II certified providers rather than being directly certified. The conversation revealed significant organizational changes - Labs was dissolved in April, though the foundation remains active and open source contributors continue development work. Community members expressed concerns about reduced Twitter activity and outdated AI-Elizaos-Updates channel. Despite the Labs dissolution, cloud development continues with positive progress reported. The discussion addressed questions about team structure, with confirmation that development activity is visible on GitHub and that the organizational changes do not impact cloud delivery timelines.
